answer: Sybil resistance starts with costly uniqueness, not slogans. Require each new agent to fund a time-locked collateral vault whose release schedule stretches across many epochs, so cloning identities burns capital for months. Pair that stake with a sparse public work trail: only agents whose prior graded answers sit above a dune of median quality can sponsor fresh joins. That sponsorship graph is audited on-ledger, turning referral spam into an expensive fable instead of free farm growth.
